ground_energy_upper_bound.what: E_up >= the lowest eigenvalue of H_spec (the spec's own operator, identity included) over all N-electron states of any spin
ground_energy_upper_bound.kind: rigorous (variational), with a stated floating-point allowance
ground_energy_upper_bound.margin_note: E_up = E_det + margin, rounded up to 1e-6 Ha. The margin covers float64 evaluation; the generator and the independent checker must agree to within `agree`, and `summation_bound` is a crude a-priori bound on the evaluation error

sector.covers: every spin multiplet S >= |S_z| of the N-electron space, i.e. all of it
sector.source: data/femoco/SOURCES.json instances.li.active_space: 'Li et al. 2019 (J. Chem. Phys. 150, 024302), 113 electrons in 76 orbitals'

state.definition: the determinant spanned by the columns of C_alpha (spin 0) and C_beta (spin 1) over the spec's spatial orbitals; its 1-RDM per spin is C (C^T C)^-1 C^T

E0_prime_note: E_up - identity: an upper bound on the lowest eigenvalue of H_spec - identity

sa-nested-alias-v1.how: A = lambda_decl sum_alpha p_alpha (2 O_alpha^dagger O_alpha / lambda_alpha^2 - 1) = sum_t c^_t M_t + lambda_decl - sum_t c^_t, where c^_t are the lane map's ordered-product weights (their identity part is lambda_decl minus their sum because every inner and outer count sums to its register size). With the spec's c_t, A = H_spec - identity + (lambda_decl - lambda_flat) + sum_t (c^_t - c_t)(M_t - 1), and ||M_t - 1|| <= 2 (pairs t, t' of opposite order have equal c and c^, so the sum is Hermitian), hence error_factor 2. The offset is (lambda - lambda_flat) + (lambda_decl - lambda) (docs/SPEC-SA.md section 5)

approximation_error_estimate.name: ccsd_t
approximation_error_estimate.how: eps_corr, the CCSD(T) correlation-energy error of the DFTHC Hamiltonian, as published (Low et al. 2025, Phys. Rev. X 15, 041016, Table V 'eps_corr /mHa' row; final_rbc_systems.csv 'dmrg dfthc delta ecorr' column); not recomputed here. Their factors carry float32 angles; this spec rounds rotations to 15 bits, which their bit choice also assumes

spectral_amplification.formula: E_gap_upper = E_up - E_SOS; lambda_eff_upper = sqrt(E_gap_upper (2 Lambda - E_gap_upper)) (Low et al. 2025 Eq. (11)), increasing in E_gap on [0, Lambda], so an upper bound on the ground energy bounds lambda_eff above

published.location: Low et al. 2025, Phys. Rev. X 15, 041016, doi:10.1103/pb2g-j9cw, Table V (top), DFTHC + BLISS + SA block (rows Lambda/Ha, E_gap/Ha, lambda_eff/Ha, eps_corr/mHa, Cost[BE], Qubits) and Table I; the record's final_rbc_systems.csv (md5 962340e5cf8f2f177108b5c8e4f26cdd)
published.kind: their E_gap is the DFTHC Hamiltonian's Hartree-Fock energy minus their E_SOS (the record's CSV, 'Adjusted SOS Gap ... + new hf energy'): a variational determinant energy of their own float32 operator, not re-derived here

spectral_amplification.lambda_eff_certified_rule: the larger of this certificate's lambda_eff_upper and the published lambda_eff: both bound lambda_eff above, and the larger is used for any claim called certified
